STOCHASTIC_IMPLEMENTATION_ATTESTED: mock_server.py sha256 5b6cf363a47794576adc842f2c334455f729eeb794ae82ca2f649e89c3b0e3d1 implements all four claimed stochastic elements: SQLite WAL-mode with per-thread connections and busy_timeout 5000 (lines 76-180), SchemaCache TTL=0.5s with stale/fresh alternation (lines 185-215, get_schema lines 405-422), jitter 10-100ms via random.uniform sleeps on DB and HTTP paths (lines 131,143,154,168,180,418,451,464,476), mixed JWT HS256 for read/write and RS256 for admin via cryptography RSA 2048 (lines 49-71, 329-359, 433-437). run_experiment.py sha256 01c49b98ad829457a77a054dcb1969a331721087e7fd5c77704a269f6b2243b6 drives 12 conditions x60 via real HTTP cycles (not analytical). Session status distribution SI conditions 401/403/500 counts (17-26 each) evidences stochastic grading; PB conditions 200 only as expected.

MEASUREMENT_VALIDITY_ACCEPTABLE_WITH_DISCLOSED_LIMITS: Behavioral composite weights (2,3,1,2) and graded session_status_check 401->1.0/403->0.5/500->0.75 are arbitrary parametric choices inherited from parent, exactly preserved per spec measurement_validity section 5; disclosed in validity_notes. Structural signal max(schema_diff,1-jaccard) is synthetic construct from unauthenticated /schema. Fisher bivariate-normality assumption mildly violated by bounded discrete behavioral (PB bimodal 0.33/0.66, SI trimodal 4.0/4.5/5.0) but n=480 and near-zero r makes transform adequate; producer discloses bounds. Cache hit rate and realized I/O latency not logged as artifact, but structural baseline lens {10,11,12} and unique baselines=60 per condition demonstrate variation. Single localhost instance, no production DB/network/CDN, claim ceiling correctly bounded to localhost.

NO_LEAKAGE_OR_CONFOUND: Behavioral channel from authenticated /api/* and /session/status (DB-backed auth) is causally separated from structural channel from unauthenticated /schema (schema_fields mutated only via set_noise/set_drift, independent of DB permission/session state). Code inspection confirms schema generation does not read permissions or sessions (mock_server.py generate_schema, apply_noise_to_schema, get_schema lines 242-282, 405-422). Inter-sample schema carryover (baseline lens varies) is representation artifact from no per-sample reset, but identical to parent design and not spuriously inflating correlation (per-condition r remain -0.104 to 0.177, all p>0.11). No data leakage across pooled correlation; n=480 independent paired samples verified.

PER_CONDITION_HETEROGENEITY_NOT_SIGNIFICANT: All 8 per-condition r p>0.17 (0.1087 p 0.408 to 0.177 p 0.175), 0/8 significant at alpha 0.05 vs expected 0.4 under null, consistent with sampling noise. Per-drift r 0.085 (PB n=240) and 0.076 (SI n=240) similarly near zero. No hidden strong per-condition correlation masked by pooling.

POWER_ANALYSIS_VERIFIED: min_detectable_r 0.08950209062260417 at n=480 recomputed tanh(1.96/sqrt(477)) matches producer. min_n for |r|=0.05 reported 1538 matches ceil(3+(1.96/atanh(0.05))^2). Observed |r| 0.0463 below detectable threshold confirms experiment is equivalence-powered at delta 0.15 but not significance-powered for point estimate, correctly interpreted.

REPRESETATION_LOSS_BOUNDED: Producer validity_notes correctly state stochastic Flask mock bounded to SQLite+cache+mixed JWT on localhost, NOT validated for production databases, distributed caches, network latency, OAuth/OIDC, SPA frontends, or delta=0.10. Infrastructure sequential per-condition servers (ports 18950-18961) could serialize DB contention, potentially reducing true stochastic concurrency vs production, but this would conservatively reduce correlation introduction, not inflate false orthogonality.
baseline_findings: B-PARENT-DETERMINISTIC-N480 comparison verified: parent n=480 r=0.0335 CI [-0.056,0.1226] CI upper 0.1226 <0.15 PASS. This experiment n=480 r=0.0463 CI [-0.043,0.135] CI upper 0.135 <0.15 PASS. Shift delta +0.0127 in upper bound attributable to stochastic DB/cache/jitter/mixed-JWT, but still well below 0.15 threshold. Demonstrates stochasticity did not introduce material correlation; effect size difference 0.0128 is sampling variation (both CIs overlap substantially). No baseline strength deficit; deterministic vs stochastic is strong contrast orthogonal to similarity heuristic.

B-STOCHASTIC-FLASK-DB-CACHE desk baseline is the tested condition itself; expectation was CI upper <0.15 if orthogonality holds. Observed 0.135 meets expectation, supporting parallel-channel architecture at delta=0.15. At stricter delta=0.10 CI upper 0.135 >0.10 FAIL (consistent with parent needing n~865 for delta=0.10), so result does not generalize to delta=0.10.

Positive control PC_PERMISSION_BOUNDARY_DETECTION 1.0000 (60/60) independently verifies permission_boundary drift still detectable despite stochastic DB reads, confirming measurement pipeline sensitivity not degraded by new infrastructure.
claim_ceiling: C-FRESHNESS orthogonality (|r|<0.15, shared variance <2.25%) holds under stochastic Flask 3.1.3 + SQLite WAL-mode + in-memory cache TTL=0.5s + jitter 10-100ms + PyJWT HS256 (read/write) / RS256 (admin) on localhost, for the 8 co-occurring conditions (2 drift x 4 noise) with N=60 per condition (n=480 paired), using the frozen behavioral composite (token*2+session_change*3+auth_boundary+session_status*2 with graded 401/403/500) and structural max(diff,1-jaccard). Ceiling: PASS at delta=0.15. NOT established at delta=0.10 (CI upper 0.135 >0.10, TOST FAIL, needs n~865), NOT for production databases/distributed caches/CDN/network/OAuth-OIDC/distributed session stores, NOT for alternative noise magnitudes or all permission subsets beyond the 3 tested, NOT for field-type normalization beyond deterministic string/integer flip, NOT for stochastic SPA frontends. Parallel-channel architecture justified ONLY where delta=0.15 acceptable and environment matches mock bounds.
